{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline or biomarker_final is -999.0
df_clean = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0)]

# Calculate the change in biomarker level (follow-up - baseline)
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Group by sex and compute mean change
df_grouped = df_clean.groupby('sex')['change'].mean().reset_index()
df_grouped"}
